painPoints.title: Do you recognize yourself?
painPoints.description: You want to launch a business in Uzbekistan but do not know where to begin. Documentation, taxes, and reporting can seem complicated and time-consuming.
painPoints.item1Desc: Unclear which documents are needed for LLC or sole proprietorship, how to fill forms, where to apply
painPoints.item2Desc: Mistakes in applications lead to rejections from authorities and lost time
painPoints.item3Desc: Fear of fines due to late filing or incorrect accounting
painPoints.item5Desc: Hours in queues and studying rules instead of running your business
painPoints.item6Desc: No one to ask about accounting, taxes, or legal changes
painPoints.conclusion: You end up spending weeks on paperwork, risk fines, and lose focus on business — instead of growing your company.

testimonials.title: What our clients say
testimonials.quote1: We launched an LLC in Tashkent — BizReg guided us through every step in two days. Documents were prepared clearly and quickly. Highly recommend.
testimonials.quote2: We were looking for outsourced accounting — they also helped us launch and now handle our books. Fair prices, quick responses.
testimonials.quote3: I want to recommend the guys for opening my business in Uzbekistan. It took just two days. Two days! Can you believe it? Together with the bank account. Ivan and Elena were very instrumental in their approach and helped me a lot. When they told me it would take a couple of days, I thought: sure — two days to initiate the process, and then two or three months for the whole thing. But in under two days I got my business bank account, my digital signature and all the papers — and the whole process was so smooth that I still cannot believe it. So thank you, thank you, thank you!
